observations: Three retail boxes for a Sonik AC/DC Pressing Iron are stacked.
The model number SPI-168DC2 is clearly printed on the boxes in photo 0.
The boxes specify a wattage of 200-250W.
Features listed on the packaging include 5 temperature modes, copper cable, and a non-stick soleplate.
The packaging indicates the iron can run on AC or DC power, with icons for solar panels and batteries.
The actual iron is not visible; only the external packaging is shown.

claims.claim: operate at a very low wattage, generally between 200W and 250W

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, damaged, or used item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual iron outside of the box.

risks.risk: The heating element or the AC/DC switching circuitry may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron powered on and reaching temperature.

proof_requests: Photo of the iron outside the box to confirm condition and presence.
Video of the iron plugged in and heating up to confirm functionality.
Photo of the base plate to check for wear or damage.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the retail packaging. It is priced at the worst case (empty box/non-functional) until the contents and operation are verified.
